courses.overview: 由時戳、路徑不對稱與時鐘伺服連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect timestamps, path asymmetry and clock servos to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 時間敏感網路
related.why: 可移植「時鐘域」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from clock domains; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「時鐘域」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from clock domains; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理時戳、路徑不對稱與時鐘伺服；「時間敏感網路」主要處理排程閘門、時間同步與可界定延遲，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes timestamps, path asymmetry and clock servos; Time-sensitive networking emphasizes scheduled gates, synchronization and bounded latency. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「時間同步 PTP 網路」與「時間敏感網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「Ordinary clock」的對照方法至「時間感知閘門」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Precision Time Protocol networks and Time-sensitive networking flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from ordinary clocks to time-aware gates, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 蜂巢式基地台整合
related.why: 可移植「時鐘域」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。

related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from clock domains; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理時戳、路徑不對稱與時鐘伺服；「蜂巢式基地台整合」主要處理基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes timestamps, path asymmetry and clock servos; Cellular base-station integration emphasizes base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「時間同步 PTP 網路」與「蜂巢式基地台整合」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「Ordinary clock」的對照方法至「射頻鏈路」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Precision Time Protocol networks and Cellular base-station integration flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from ordinary clocks to rf chain, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
